drafts.title: Great Idea
drafts.pitch: Cursor pitches ideas to the back wall of the context room, which agrees with everything, and is overjoyed when Tilde says no.
drafts.reason: Clear setup and "Briefly." is a good button, but the wall is a new talking prop and two identical "Great idea." beats read slower than the calibration strips.

drafts.title: Echo
drafts.pitch: Cursor shouts an idea into the empty context and the echo agrees, then Null relays a no from the user and Cursor is thrilled.
drafts.reason: The echo gag is familiar and panel 2 is flat; a no relayed from the user weakens the someone-is-looking idea, and "Someone is." is the softest closer.
